name: Yoake no Rideau
source:
The end of the Taisho era. Men gather at the Otome Tsubaki Mansion in search of "the best night ever." However, what awaits them there is an encounter with a virgin succubus king. 

What is this ritual? What is a succubus? What is a human? 

When dawn breaks, what will remain? Love, or something else entirely? 

Your Majesty, let us begin the "Ritual of Love."
